steps.label: Tilt and width
steps.say: the tone tilted, the stereo wider or narrower
steps.tip: An example node to copy: the tone tilted about a pivot (the highs up and the lows down by half the tilt each, or the other way), the stereo made wider or narrower, the file back as loud as it came and never clipped. A page of what it did beside the sound.

params.label: Tilt, dB
params.tip: Plus: brighter (the highs up, the lows down, half each); minus: darker

params.label: About
params.tip: The frequency that stays where it was

params.label: Width, %
params.tip: 100 leaves the stereo as it is, 0 makes it mono, 150 half again as wide

params.label: As loud as it came
params.tip: The result turned to the loudness it came at, so you hear the change and not the level

steps.label: Width meter
steps.tip: An example of a node that only looks: the stereo's width, correlation and the balance of left and right in the lows, the mids and the highs, as a page in the tree and a line beside its branch. It changes nothing.
